2.293.7
Style.BorderColor
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Style.BorderColor element specifies the color of a border. This element is optional and is of type
BorderColor.
Following is the parent element of the Style.BorderColor element.
Parent elements
Style
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Style.BorderColor element.
 <xsd:element name="BorderColor" type="BorderColorStyleWidthType" minOccurs="0" />
